channel.title: Bad Bytes
channel.description: A daily, deeply unprofessional rundown of what's happening in K-12 IT: Intune, Entra, Verkada, AI, school cybersecurity and whatever else is on the horizon. Hosted by Rocco and Benji, who should not be trusted with Global Admin.
